scenes.title: OpenAI dots
scenes.sub: Always-on agents in ChatGPT, powered by GPT-6 Astra.
scenes.say: These are OpenAI dots, always-on agents in ChatGPT, powered by GPT-6 Astra.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Each dot has its own cloud computer and browser
scenes.say: Each dot has its own cloud computer and browser, and connects to more than four thousand apps through plugins.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: A cloud computer and browser per dot
scenes.say: Dots are hosted by OpenAI inside ChatGPT. You can work with them in ChatGPT, in Slack or Teams, or by voice.

scenes.heading: Timeline
items: Pro and Business Premium, Enterprise beta
scenes.say: Dots launched at OpenAI DevDay on September 29, 2026, and are rolling out to Pro and Business Premium, with an Enterprise beta.
